title: Post-GE14 Fuel Price Stabilization
description: Government stabilized RON95 retail price at RM 2.20/L following the 14th General Election.

title: Automatic Pricing Mechanism (APM) Resumption
description: Weekly managed float under the Automatic Pricing Mechanism (APM) formula was reintroduced.

title: Russia-Saudi Oil Price War
description: OPEC+ negotiations broke down, triggering a price war that caused global crude oil benchmarks to plummet.

title: COVID-19 MCO & Global Demand Collapse
description: Worldwide lockdowns collapsed transportation fuel demand; Malaysian retail RON95 dropped to a historic low of RM 1.25/L in April 2020.

title: Retail Fuel Ceiling Price Implementation
description: Government instituted ceiling prices of RM 2.05/L for RON95 and RM 2.15/L for Diesel to shield the public from rising crude prices.

title: Russia-Ukraine War Outbreak
description: Geopolitical conflict and energy sanctions pushed Brent crude above $130/bbl; uncapped RON97 soared to an all-time record of RM 4.84/L.

title: OPEC+ 2 Million BPD Production Cut
description: OPEC+ agreed to its largest oil production cut since 2020 (2M barrels per day) to support falling crude prices.

title: Middle East Conflict & Supply Route Risks
description: Escalation in the Middle East raised shipping risk premiums through key maritime oil transit chokepoints.

title: Peninsular Diesel Subsidy Rationalization (BUDI MADANI)
description: Peninsular Malaysia diesel price was floated from RM 2.15 to RM 3.35/L alongside BUDI MADANI cash transfers and SKDS fleet quotas.

title: Budget 2025 Targeted RON95 Announcement
description: Government announced targeted subsidy rationalization for RON95 scheduled for mid-2025 to curb subsidy leakage.
